messages:
tasha p: quick flag 30 post-canary we see ~0.27% failures in eu1 embeddings from kvcache type mismatch. proposing an expedited late-window hotfix.
omar (oncall): paste the minimal log and rollback plan pls.
tasha p: log snippet:
```
ERROR embeddings-eu1: kvcache lookup type mismatch id=0x9f
```
Rollback: `/deploy rollback embeddings-eu1 v2026-03-embed-76` or pin older sha. Perf: +0.2ms p50.
maria chen: relnotes stub ready: "hotfix: embeddings-eu1 kvcache defensive type-check + cache regen" 30 will PR.
omar (oncall): criteria: compressed canary (5% 4m, 50% 8m) -> full if error <=0.4% and p95 within +10%. rollback if error >0.6% or sustained cpu>70% 2m. Need SRE signoff.
sre-watch: SRE ack on thresholds. monitoring hooks enabled.
release-bot: Deployment request created by tasha p for service=embeddings-eu1 version=v2026-03-hotfix-34 image=sha256:ff12ce. Approvers notified.
tasha p: kicking deploy with --expedite:
```
/deploy embeddings-eu1 v2026-03-hotfix-34 --pin --expedite --canary=5% --smoke=4m
```
release-bot: canary started at 3897660003. logs: https://go/logs/deploy/3897659999
sre-watch: 4m canary: error=0.03%, p95 +0.1ms. green, ramping to 50%.
tasha p: bump to 50% for 8m.
release-bot: ramp to 50% at 3897660020.
omar (oncall): 6m in, metrics stable. proceeding to 100% over 6m.
release-bot: final ramp complete at 3897660040. traffic at 100%.
maria chen: relnotes PR merged and emailed.
omar (oncall): marking expedited approval. rollback command repeated above. keeping watch for 30m.
tasha p: thanks all, will open follow-up if anything pops. :thumbsup:
